<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def eyes():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S':
            bb=n['boundary']; rr=[p[0] for p in bb]; cc=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((min(rr),max(rr),min(cc),max(cc)))
    return sorted(out)
def diffsum():
    b=last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ch=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if b[r][c]!=a[r][c]]
    if ch:
        rs=[p[0] for p in ch]; cs=[p[1] for p in ch]
        return len(ch),min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs), ch[:8]
    return 0
print('before SPACE:', eyes())
action(['SPACE'])
print('after SPACE:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('no_impact'), eyes(), diffsum())
print('before MOUSE(46,21):', eyes())
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':46,'col':21}])
print('after MOUSE:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('no_impact'), eyes(), diffsum())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
